psych-beh-01-c3.text: John B. Watson and Rosalie Rayner (1920). Conditioned emotional reactions. Journal of Experimental Psychology, 3(1), 1-14 (full text via Classics in the History of Psychology, York University).
psych-beh-01-c3.quote: We did not begin this work until Albert was eleven months, three days of age.
psych-beh-01-c3.claim: They presented an 11-month-old infant with a white rat, which was initially neutral.

psych-beh-01-c3.text: John B. Watson and Rosalie Rayner (1920). Conditioned emotional reactions. Journal of Experimental Psychology, 3(1), 1-14 (full text via Classics in the History of Psychology, York University).
psych-beh-01-c3.quote: In all seven joint stimulations were given to bring about the complete reaction.
psych-beh-01-c3.claim: After only seven pairings, Albert cried at the mere sight of the rat.
